posts.text:
Scientists copied a fruit fly’s entire brain into a computer and connected it to a virtual body

Nobody programmed it to do anything, but it started tasting sugar and cleaning itself anyway

It’s a long way from a human brain, but it’s hard not to think about where this goes! https://t.co/5t8dIRb6dR
posts.text_zh:
科学家把一只果蝇的整个大脑复制进了电脑，并把它连接到一个虚拟身体上

没有人给它编程去做任何事，但它自己就开始品尝糖分、清理自己

这离人类大脑还很远，但很难不去想这会走向何方！https://t.co/5t8dIRb6dR
